title: Callicraditas
summary: Raleigh names Callicraditas in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Callicraditas, Admirall of the Lacedaemonians, who lost the honour of the day at Arginusae, and died valiantly in the fight. The printed spelling is kept. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book III, Part I, Chapter VIII, §. XI, sig. 432b–433a
